usedFor: Guru is the knowledge base, Google Sheets is the log, and “Card Verified” can feed “Update Spreadsheet Row”.

bestTemplate.name: “Card Verified” in Guru, then “Update Spreadsheet Row” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: A verified card can update a row, so a sheet can show which knowledge has been checked.

watchOut: “Update Spreadsheet Row” edits existing rows and does not add new ones for events like “Card Viewed”.
